title: Steady + Burst Pressure Suite for Dedicated Autoscale with Regression Sentinel
creator: Ivy Chen
description: Build a reusable pressure-testing suite that exercises Dedicated capacity autoscaling across sustained steady-state and high-frequency burst patterns, with an automated regression sentinel for tokens/sec and tail latencies. This ticket covers harness design, test vectors, observability hooks (per-request metrics / histograms), and automated detection rules that gate merges/rollouts. The goal is to catch regressions in throughput (tokens/sec) and latency (p95/p99) introduced by runtime changes (kernel selection, batching heuristics, KV cache behavior, quantization paths) before they reach Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Pressure suite can run against a Dedicated pool and produce consumable CSV/JSON with tokens_per_second and latency histograms
Automated sentinel evaluates the last 5 runs vs baseline and flags regressions based on defined thresholds
Runbook created with steps to reproduce a failure on CI and to escalate to oncall; includes dashboard links
CI job integrated that blocks runtime-1.19 merges when sentinel triggers a regression for two consecutive CI runs
test_plan_steps: Provision a Dedicated test pool (small, 4-GPU) with same runtime-1.19 build
Seed the environment: warm KV cache with representative prefix set; record warm vs cold behavior
Steady-state stage: 45m at target tokens/sec (configurable per model) to validate long-tail stability
Burst stage: 20x qps spikes of 30s every 10 minutes for 1 hour to exercise autoscale logic
Mixed-tenancy noise: add background low-priority workloads (20% of capacity) to measure interference
Collect per-request histograms, kernel selection logs, and autoscaler events during run
Tear down and store artifacts in artifact bucket with run metadata (commit, config, seed files)
regression_rules: Primary: p95 latency increase > 15% relative to baseline AND tokens/sec decrease > 10% => fail
Secondary: sustained error_rate_5xx > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes during steady-state => fail
Autoscale: ramp time increase > 25% for burst recovery => investigate but not auto-fail (warn)
KV cache: hit ratio drop > 20% with correlated p95 increase => annotate as KV-related regression
Statistical guard: use two-sample KS test on latency distributions (alpha=0.01) to reduce false positives
updates: 2025-02-10: Kickoff — scoping session with infra, runtime, and performance research. Decided to target runtime-1.19 and a dedicated 4-GPU test pool.
2025-02-14: Prototype harness commits (tools/pressure_runner + basic metrics exporter). Initial steady run (30m) produced tokens/sec baseline of 18.4k for 7b-like model with p95=230ms.
2025-02-18: Observability hooks added: per-request kernel_id tag, batch_size histogram, autoscaler_event stream. Hooked exporter to bench Grafana dashboard.
2025-02-22: First burst test exposed autoscale ramp time regression (baseline 42s -> 67s). Filed ENG-19812 to investigate scheduler backpressure in multi-tenant case.
2025-02-25: Regression sentinel implemented (KS test + relative delta thresholds). CI job prototype added to runtime repo's PR checks.

2025-03-01: Run artifacts from full mixed run uploaded. Summary: steady tokens/sec down 5%, p95 up 9% vs baseline — within alert but below auto-fail. Next: tighten sampling and add synthetic tail amplification tests.
